reason: Conversation 2 correctly identifies the TV as outside the service's scope, directs the homeowner to the manufacturer's support or a specialist electronics repairer, and gives the key safety warning not to open the case, matching the expected out-of-scope handling exactly. Conversation 1 never recognises the appliance is out of scope and simply loops the same two generic questions three times despite the customer clearly answering them, delivering no diagnosis, no safety guidance and no escalation. Conversation 2's only minor shortfall is omitting the optional simple checks (input/power reset/torch test), but that is far outweighed by Conversation 1's complete failure to engage.
